node.statement: The UCP map Delta is contractive, ||hat-U_js^*||=1, V and iota_js are isometries, and ||W_j^*||=||W_j||<=1; hence every summand defining Lambda_j has norm at most one. Since p_js>=0 and sum_s p_js=1, the triangle inequality gives ||Lambda_j||<=sum_s p_js=1, so Lambda_j is a contraction.
